x: 30 Crystal Palace, SEAA Indoor Champs. 60mH: 1, N.Owen 8.0 (CBP). U20 60mH: 2, D.Holden 8.8.
DT: D.Holden 32.38; 1 V.Hassell 19.10. JT: 2 V.Thompson 30.02; 2 V.Hassell 25.38.

Diana Holden, without a solid winter's training behind her, was not yet breaching the 50 metres barrier but it was sufficient to win. Shelley Newman in the outside throwing area did not seem to be distracted by the regular passage of cars behind the cage on the way to the overflow car park and managed 55.42 metres.
For the women Diana Holden threw a season's best to finish fourth in the hammer (one better than last year) and then managed a sixth place in the discus.
Hence we learnt that Diana Holden's 52.88 in the hammer, Lucy Webber's 3.40 in the pole vault, and Eva Massey's 14.98 in the shot were all Grade 1 performances.
Diana Holden who had missed some training over the winter due to illness still managed to hurtle the hammer to beyond 48 metres for second place.
